Mixed adult model casting is independent of the location.

reconstructionNotice: The cleaning cloth is a scene prop, not a product. The silver rounded eyeglasses are held in the hands and listed as a wearable product; their far temple is inferred. The hands and rolled cuffs cover part of the sage band-collar overshirt and ecru knit, which are conservatively reconstructed with the back. Brown socks show above the brown penny loafers. Brand, metal, lens properties, fibre composition and retail identity are unknown.

findings: Actual view_image review of all five look overview sheets; all 28 isolated products, complete pairs and straps, no outfit collages or props; clean final composites on four backgrounds.

copy.titleEn: A PAUSE TO CLEAN THE GLASSES

title.en: A pause to clean the glasses

deck.ko: 세이지 밴드칼라와 에크루 니트의 부드러운 층.
deck.en: Sage band collar meets soft ecru knit.
deck.de: Salbeigrüner Stehkragen trifft auf weichen Ecrustrick.

intro.ko: 안경을 벗어 손에 들고 렌즈를 닦습니다.
intro.en: He removes the glasses and holds them in his hands to clean a lens.
intro.de: Er nimmt die Brille ab und hält sie zum Reinigen eines Glases in den Händen.

body.ko: 낮은 칼라의 세이지 오버셔츠 아래 에크루 니트가 보입니다. 토프 바지는 넓고 곧게 떨어져 갈색 양말과 로퍼에 닿습니다. 손에 든 가는 은색 안경은 낮은 색 대비 안에서 작은 빛을 남기고 직광 플래시가 옷의 주름과 둥근 테를 구분합니다.
body.en: Ecru knit shows under a low-collared sage overshirt. Wide straight taupe trousers reach brown socks and loafers. Fine silver-tone glasses catch a small glint within the low-contrast palette, while direct flash distinguishes clothing folds from the rounded frames.
body.de: Ecrustrick zeigt sich unter dem niedrigen Kragen des salbeifarbenen Overshirts. Weite gerade taupefarbene Hosen reichen zu braunen Socken und Loafern. Die feine silberfarbene Brille setzt einen kleinen Lichtpunkt; direkter Blitz trennt Kleidungsfalten von der runden Fassung.

pull.en: A pale neckline below a low collar.
pull.de: Ein heller Ausschnitt unter einem niedrigen Kragen.

copy.pullQuoteEn: A pale neckline below a low collar.

tip.ko: 커프를 조금 올리고 안경은 다리를 잡아 렌즈에 지문이 남지 않게 하세요.
tip.en: Raise the cuffs slightly and hold a temple to keep fingerprints off the lenses.
tip.de: Die Manschetten etwas hochschieben und die Brille am Bügel halten, damit die Gläser sauber bleiben.

description.ko: 낮은 밴드칼라와 가슴 패치 포켓, 앞 단추의 긴소매 셔츠입니다.
description.en: Long-sleeved shirt with low band collar, chest patch pocket and front buttons.
description.de: Langärmliges Hemd mit niedrigem Stehkragen, Brusttasche und Vorderknöpfen.

howToWear.ko: 안경을 닦을 때 커프를 살짝 올려 손목을 비우세요.
howToWear.en: Push the cuffs up slightly while cleaning the glasses.
howToWear.de: Beim Brillenputzen die Manschetten leicht hochschieben.
